recipe.visualDefinition: A grid-based composition featuring a central large monochrome photograph surrounded by smaller repeating monochrome images, all mounted with gold photo corners onto a textured navy blue background, topped with expressive script lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Central large photo as the primary focal point
Repeating grid of smaller photos creating a rhythmic border
Gold photo corners anchoring every image to the dark blue field
High-contrast white script against the dark background for legibility
coreInvariants: Deckle-edged white borders on all photographs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large square photo is centered horizontally and vertically; smaller versions of the same or similar photos form a 3x3 grid around it.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central large photograph and the top-centered white script.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top script, drops to the central large photo, then radiates outward to the repeating grid elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial navy blue space between the grid elements, acting as the 'album page'.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy blue background providing a somber, nostalgic foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for photo borders and script lettering to ensure high visibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold for the photo corners, adding a tactile, physical quality.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark blue and bright white elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with varying line weights
letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thin upstrokes and thick downstrokes
Informal, hand-drawn quality with slight irregularities
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature dramatic, looping flourishes
Lowercase letters are compact with tight connections
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script used for all text elements to maintain a personal, handwritten feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the era and fluid motion of the original lettering.
Captures the elegance and the aged feel of the cover.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a textured navy blue background. Arrange a 3x3 grid of monochrome vintage photographs. The center photo should be twice the size of the others. Each photo must have a white deckle-edged border and four gold-colored triangular photo corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom white calligraphic script centered in the top third of the composition. The script should have a hand-drawn, slightly distressed quality with elegant flourishes.

verificationChecks: Are there gold photo corners on every image?
Is the background a consistent textured navy blue?
Are the photos monochrome with deckle edges?
Is the text centered and rendered in a white script?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script is legible against the dark blue.
Verify the deckle edge effect looks organic and not repetitive.
Confirm the gold corners are positioned correctly at the angles of the photos.
recipe.reuseFormula: Navy blue field + 3x3 grid of deckle-edged B&W photos + gold photo corners + top-centered white decorative script.
